title: Classification of representations of higher-rank graph C*-algebras
summary: We develop new techniques for the construction and classification of representations of row-finite and locally convex higher-rank graph C*-algebras O. This class includes Cuntz--Krieger algebras associated to row-finite directed graphs. Our approach relies on the representation theory of a certain non-self-adjoint algebra and a lifting process of representations. We introduce a novel dimension vector for representations of O yielding a countable partition of the spectrum.
